title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Codepeople…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Codepeople Appointment Hour Booking plugin versions up to 1.6.06. This vulnerability allows an attacker with low privileges to inject malicious scripts that can be executed in the context of other users. The flaw arises from improper neutralization of input during web page generation.
